question: Is there one named job in your company that owns security decisions?
Do you have written security rules that your staff have to follow?
Do you keep an up-to-date list of the computers and servers your business uses?
Do you keep a list of the software and online services your staff use for work?
Does every member of staff have their own login, never one shared between people?
Do staff need a second step to log in, such as a code on their phone?
Do you take away a person's access on the day they leave?
Do you keep records of who signed in and what they changed?
Does something watch those records and raise an alarm when they look wrong?
Do you have a written plan for what to do after a break-in?
Do you have a written plan for getting the service running again after a serious outage?
Do you know how long it would take to get back to normal, and have you written that number down?
